name: sweden-vat-return
description: Swedish VAT (moms) and the VAT return (momsdeklaration) for 2026, for a business registered or registering for VAT in Sweden. Covers the 25%, 12% and 6% rates and their 2026 scope, including the temporary 6% food rate from 1 April 2026 to 31 December 2027 and 6% on dance events from 1 July 2026; the SEK 120,000 small-business exemption and the EU SME scheme (EUR 100,000); monthly, quarterly and annual periods by turnover with their deadlines; input VAT limits (cars, representation, mixed use); domestic reverse charge (construction, scrap, gold, phones and laptops); every return field; the EC Sales List (periodisk sammanställning); and förseningsavgift, skattetillägg and kostnadsränta. Trigger phrases: moms, momsdeklaration, momssats, omvänd betalningsskyldighet, periodisk sammanställning, momsbefrielse, Swedish VAT return, skattedeklaration, prepare VAT return, classify transactions for VAT. Out of scope: income tax (se-income-tax, se-corporate-tax), payroll (sweden-payroll), cross-bor
